title: Sound-cued look: with 12 or fewer alive and nothing to shoot, turn the torso to the last heard mech sound (EARS_LOOK_ON)
behaviors: with obs.alive <= 12, t >= 10, no target (no enemy and no farm mark), not hit in the last 2 s, no laser charge in progress, no drop run/hold and no claimable drop within DROP_RUN_M: aim the torso (yaw only, pitch 0) at the bearing of the most recent mech-made sound heard in the last 2 s when that bearing is more than 30 deg off the aim the champion would use
decision: Coordinator after Sim Tester screen of PR #173 (comment 2026-11-22 05:34Z, screens.csv): VETO, 2 vetoes vs P48 b9492c6. Stall (b) seed 2021 new 24 s pause at t=120–144 at a new spot (11th died 212.4 s → 12th died 171.2 s), confirmed isolated. Stall (c): 20 s+ pause games 2 to 3 on both sets (new 2021 and 5036). Passed: flag-0 96/96, timing max 10.7 ms, drops 7=7 and 5=5, deaths <40 s 48 to 47 and 38=38, stall (a). Survivors 2 to 1 (seed 2052 only) and 3 to 4. Sim +0.052 ± 0.056 and +0.042 ± 0.050, information only. Mac screen was PASS (no vetoes) with survivors 2→1 on 2000+3000; official tester verdict counts. Not a near miss (more than one veto). Retired; no rebuild started.
blocker: Two stall vetoes (b and c). Not near-miss eligible.
next_action: None. A stall-guarded follow-up would be a new idea citing F5; none is assigned.
single_decision: Where the torso points when the champion has no target. Today (brain.ts:913, :1102-1115) it points along the move direction, or at the next circle's center when standing, and at the last hit's bearing for 2 s after a hit. The bot never reads obs.sounds (no reference in brain.ts/target.ts/nav.ts). The flag adds one more aim source after the lastHit line: the newest heard mech sound. Legs, path, fire rules and target pick are unchanged.
trigger: EARS_LOOK_ON AND obs.t >= 10 AND obs.alive <= 12 AND no target after the target/farm pick (`!target`, brain.ts:1004) AND NOT (lastHit && obs.t - lastHit.t < 2) AND laser charge <= 0 (beamCharge, brain.ts:935) AND NOT dropMove AND NOT dropHold AND NOT dropNear (same test as brain.ts:853) AND the newest sound of kind step/boost/jet/gun/laser/laser_charge/lightning/reload/mortar has (obs.t - heard_at) <= 2 s AND |wrap(sound.bearing - aim[0])| > 30 deg. Not counted: npc_gun, crate, explosion, death, drop (not a mech, or no shooter position).
hook: brain.ts remember() (brain.ts:448-474): keep `lastSound = {bearing, at: obs.t - s.age, kind}` from obs.sounds (protocol.md section 8: sounds arrive once, with bearing, dist band and age). brain.ts act(), no-target branch brain.ts:1102-1118: after `if (lastHit && obs.t - lastHit.t < 2) aim = [lastHit.bearing, 0]` (brain.ts:1115) add `else if (EARS_LOOK_ON && <trigger>) aim = [lastSound.bearing, 0]`. dropMove/dropHold/dropNear are in scope (brain.ts:724-746, :853). Flag + EARS_ALIVE/EARS_AGE_S/EARS_MIN_DEG in params.ts next to MIDRING_SETTLE_ON.
gates: Cannot start before t = 10 s (explicit obs.t >= 10). Only with obs.alive <= 12. Off on any tick with dropMove or dropHold, or with a claimable drop (holder null or us) within DROP_RUN_M; the aim then is the champion's (so a drop run's torso is never turned). No movement change of any kind. Off = champion exactly (flag false short-circuits).
drop_gate: Uses the NARROW gate (no claimable drop within DROP_RUN_M, never during dropMove/dropHold), not the plain obs.drops-empty gate. The plain gate would keep only 18/192 and 10/192 games (the second set is at the bar) because a called or untaken drop sits in obs.drops for most of the mid game; the narrow gate keeps 22/192 and 21/192. Plain gate = obs.drops is empty. Narrow gate = no drop with holder null or us within DROP_RUN_M (200 m), the same `dropNear` test P29 uses (brain.ts:853), and the champion's dropMove/dropHold are both off on that tick.

evidence.sim_state: Run 1, champion: with <= 12 alive the champion has no target on 8,908 decisions (2000+3000) and 12,049 (4000+5000). With <= 8 alive it has no target on 50%, 54%, 68%, 55% of decisions (bases 2000/3000/4000/5000), and a known enemy (seen in the last 10 s) on only 408/3317, 210/1769, 14/4556, 756/4988 of those, so the champion's own memory rarely says where the hunters are; a heard sound often does.
evidence.sim_sounds: Run 2, narrow-gated activations (episodes) by sound kind, 2000+3000: gun 19, boost 13, mortar 7, laser 6, step 4, laser_charge 4; dist band mid 39, near 11, far 3. 4000+5000: boost 14, gun 13, mortar 5, laser 2, step 2, laser_charge 2, reload 1. A mech target appeared within 3 s after 21/53 and 18/39 episodes (champion, no change applied).
evidence.sim_squad: /tmp/wild-sim/tune.ts SQUAD: every house bot hunts us from 240 s or once 8 or fewer house bots are left; they find us by sight and by our gunfire within 320 m. The sound-cued look answers that convergence.

trigger_counts.alive_le_8_gate_rejected: With obs.alive <= 8 (the requested late window) the same trigger fires in 7/192 (plain 2, narrow 6) and 5/192 (plain 0, narrow 5) games, under the 10/192 bar on both sets, so the spec uses <= 12 (the Watcher's alive_9_12 bucket edge). Only 15/192 and 21/192 games reach <= 8 alive with our bot alive.
trigger_counts.episode_definition: an episode is a run of trigger decisions with no gap over 1 s; decisions are 0.1 s

estimated_activation: 22/192 (2000+3000) and 21/192 (4000+5000) games with the narrow drop gate; 53 and 39 episodes.
closest_prior_test: No test has used obs.sounds. Aim-only cousins: B45 TRACK_SWEEP_ON (glance away from a far harmless target to find a laser, opening) LOSS 3.35 vs 3.67; P23 late idle torso sweep VETO (64 s pin) and P23b CLOSE 4.00 (BB-AEFC0FA8); P30 front-arc facing toward a visible attacker while retreating/healing, RETIRED (drop arrivals 6->4, deaths <40 s up). This differs: a single look at a heard source, only with no target and no recent hit, never in the opening (B45), never a sweep (P23), never during a drop run (P30's loss).
what_would_disprove: Paired screen: fires < 10/192 on either set; no rise in the share of fights after an activation where we land the first hit; or drop-ring set totals below the champion, deaths < 40 s above, or a new 20 s+ pin in a window where the look was active. An official score at or below 4.35.
risks: Pins: no movement change, but a new view can surface a cube, drone or weapon and start a farm/loot walk the champion would not have made (P23's failure mode); check 20 s+ pins. Drops: off during dropMove/dropHold and with a claimable drop within 200 m. Early deaths: off before 10 s and only at <= 12 alive. Fights: seeing a hunter sooner also starts fights sooner (engage, standoff break and crossfire run on what we see); looking away from the move direction can hide an enemy ahead on a zone trip. Gun sounds include house bots shooting drones.

trigger_counts_trees_on.gates: Gates as counted: none; plain = obs.drops empty; narrow = no drop (holder null or us) within DROP_RUN_M and no dropMove/dropHold; reach = 'near AND reachable within DROP_RUN_M' (Doug 8:58 PM ET follow-up): no drop that passes the champion's own drop-run candidate filter (not in dropSkip, holder null or us, within DROP_RUN_M, zone-safe for lands_in + capture time; brain.ts:731-736 on main 8c130ad) and no dropMove/dropHold that tick. Spec gate = reach.

trees_on_change: Fires more often with trees on: reach-gated 30/192 and 30/192 games (trees off on P29: narrow 22 and 21). Trees hide hunters beyond 45 m from our view too (shots and sounds ignore trees), so 'no target while a mech is heard' happens more; that strengthens the case for a sound cue. The <= 8 alive gate still fails trees on (5/192 and 6/192 games), so the <= 12 gate stands. The plain gate stays weak (19 and 13).

hypothesis: With 12 or fewer alive and nothing to shoot, turning the torso toward a recent mech-made sound could start fights sooner. Source: research P41–44 / Watcher slices (P41.json source field).
mechanism: EARS_LOOK_ON: when alive <= 12, no target, and a mech sound <= 2 s old is more than 30 deg off aim, yaw-only turn to that sound. Legs, path, fire, and target pick unchanged. Drop gate: off on a drop run/hold or a near-and-reachable drop. SHA c21d23b, PR #173.
